title: Lower limits on main wind-force-resisting system.
officialText:
Base overturning moments determined from wind tunnel
testing shall be limited to not less than 80 percent of the design base overturning moments determined in accordance with
Section 6.5 of ASCE 7, unless specific testing is performed that demonstrates that lower vaults result from the aerodynamic
coefficient of the building, rather than shielding from other structures. The 80-percent limit shall be permitted to be adjusted
by the ratio of the frame load at critical wind directions as determined from wind tunnel testing without specific adjacent
buildings, but including appropriate upwind roughness, to that determined in Section 6.5 of ASCE 7. In no case shall the
limiting value be less than 50 percent of the design base overturning moments determined in accordance with Section 6.5 of
ASCE 7.
